WITH college_counts AS (
  SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM player_college
  WHERE college_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY college_id
),
sum_counts AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) as total
  FROM college_counts
),
ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    college_id,
    cnt,
    CAST(cnt AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total FROM sum_counts) as ratio
  FROM college_counts
  WHERE (SELECT total FROM sum_counts) IS NOT NULL
),
avg_cnt AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_count
  FROM college_counts
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    r.cnt,
    r.ratio,
    a.avg_count,
    r.cnt - a.avg_count as cnt_minus_avg
  FROM ratios r, avg_cnt a
  WHERE r.cnt > a.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(CASE WHEN cnt IS NOT NULL THEN cnt END) as avg_kept_count,
  AVG(CASE WHEN ratio IS NOT NULL THEN ratio END) as avg_ratio,
  AVG(CASE WHEN cnt_minus_avg IS NOT NULL THEN cnt_minus_avg END) as avg_cnt_minus_avg
FROM filtered
